title: Computational Depth Measurement in Thermographic Video: Overcoming Spatial Overfitting via Spatio-Temporal Decoupling
abstract: arXiv:2608.29223v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate through-thickness measurement of subsurface delamination depth in Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer (CFRP) is important for structural assessment because defect location determines affected load-bearing layers. Optical pulsed thermography (OPT) provides a two-dimensional thermal video rather than volumetric measurements, so depth must be inferred from temporal heat-diffusion responses. A challenge is spatial dataset bias: when calibration defects follow regular grids, regression models may memorize their geometry instead of learning physical relationship between thermal decay and depth. This work introduces a spatio-temporal decoupling architecture that separates spatial defect localization from temporal depth measurement. Defect regions are first localized using segmentation methods, after which thermal responses are spatially averaged and converted into sixteen physics-informed temporal, energy, statistical, and geometric featur

translated_title: 热成像视频中的计算式深度测量：通过时空解耦克服空间过拟合
translated_abstract: 碳纤维增强聚合物（CFRP）中地下分层深度的精确贯穿厚度测量对结构评估至关重要，因为缺陷位置决定了受影响的承重层。光学脉冲热成像（OPT）提供的是二维热视频而非体积测量，因此必须从时间上的热扩散响应来推断深度。一个关键挑战是空间数据集偏差：当校准缺陷按规则网格排列时，回归模型可能会记住缺陷的几何布局，而不是学习热衰减与深度之间的物理关系。这项工作引入了一种时空解耦架构，将空间缺陷定位与时间深度测量分离开来。首先使用分割方法定位缺陷区域，随后对热响应进行空间平均，并将其转换为十六个基于物理信息的时间、能量、统计和几何特征。
tldr: 该论文提出一种时空解耦架构，先用分割方法定位缺陷区域，再将空间平均后的热响应转化为基于物理信息的十六个特征进行深度回归，从而克服规则网格校准缺陷带来的空间过拟合问题，实现CFRP分层深度的可靠测量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a spatio-temporal decoupling architecture that separates spatial defect localization from temporal depth estimation using sixteen physics-informed features derived from spatially averaged thermal responses, overcoming spatial dataset bias from grid-arranged calibration defects for reliable delamination depth measurement in CFRP.
